summary.text: Elijah Tidswell is a write-in candidate for the Montana State Senate, District 22, in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Tidswell also completed a Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey in 2022 for the Montana State Senate; in it he described himself as a recent high school graduate who had worked on several campaigns, including as campaign manager for a successful local city council candidate.

sources.title: Elijah Tidswell - Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey
